I was playing stronghold crusader and had all these wheat farms and flour mills, but my stockpile of flour was getting too full. I had to build more bakeries. That is what made me think, "I should try to make some bread."

You can get nice brand new bread machines less than $10 at any thrift store, I make dozens of recipes in mine, then after the first rise, I remove and finish in the oven, I don't want to knead bread all day so I love my machine, but most will tell you they aren't very good at baking. Start with basic, flour, oil, water, salt sugar & yeast, then build, you can add egg, powdered milk, yogurt, and after the first rise, add nuts, seeds, cheeses, even jalapenos, almost anything. Sugars feed yeast. Salt inhibits yeast too so go easy. Cinnamon really inhibits yeast, so if you want cinnamon rolls/bread, add after the first rise or when you roll out the dough. Burger buns, take an extra 5 minutes to roll into balls and smash and are heavenly compared to store bought. Pizza dough, no comparison, I reduce flour and add semolina flour. It's so much fun to experiment, and with a bread machine doing all the heavy work kneading, it's easy and less clean up.
